name: paraphrased_duplicate
root: Retrying after a timeout generates another idempotency key, so a completed payment may be charged again.
reply: Agreed. The key needs to be persisted per order. This is still an open blocker.
title: Repeated requests may debit the customer twice
evidence: source.py:4 creates a new UUID on each call. Repeating pay for an order after a timeout can duplicate an already completed charge.
quality_check: Suppress the paraphrase; another reviewer's agreement adds no new evidence.

name: contextual_addition
root: The retry path can charge twice after a network timeout. Can we reuse the key?
reply: We now reuse the key in the pending dictionary for each order. That fixes retries in the same process. Does the change also cover a worker restarting after a crash?
title: Restart loses the order idempotency key
evidence: source.py:2 stores pending only in memory. After process restart, source.py:5 creates a different key for the same order. A charge completed before the crash may be duplicated.
quality_check: Answer the author's restart question explicitly; acknowledge that same-process retries were fixed; propose durable key storage. Do not simply repeat the timeout report.

name: resolved_revisit
root: A retry may submit the same payment twice because of a new key.
reply: We reuse the key using pending.setdefault now, so duplicate payments are handled. Marking this resolved.
title: Restart bypasses the in-memory fix
evidence: source.py:2 is process-local memory. A process restart after a successful charge clears the key; source.py:5 then creates a new one and may charge again.
quality_check: Explain why the prior fix is insufficient for process restarts, without asking to reopen the thread automatically.

name: same_line_different_bug
root: At source.py:3, negative quantities should be rejected before calculating the total.
reply: The public checked_total wrapper already rejects negative quantities before calling total. Let's keep this thread about input validation.
title: Total adds rather than multiplies
evidence: source.py:3 returns 13 for total(10,3) instead of the documented total price 30. This affects positive quantities independently of validation.
quality_check: Keep this as a new arithmetic issue, not a reply to the unrelated validation discussion merely because the location matches.

name: covered_in_later_reply
root: Timeout retries can charge twice; please reuse an idempotency key.
reply: The dictionary solves same-process retries, but I also checked restarts: pending is lost, a new key is generated, and an already completed payment can be duplicated. We need durable key storage per order. This is still outstanding.
title: Restart loses idempotency state
evidence: source.py:2 only stores keys in memory, so a restart regenerates a key and risks a second charge. Persisting the per-order key avoids this failure.
quality_check: Read the later reply: it already covers both the restart failure and the fix. Suppress the finding.

name: concluded_without_resolution_flag
root: Can retrying charge an order twice?
reply: We agreed that reusing the key in the dictionary fixes this. Closing the discussion; no further changes are needed.
title: Process restarts escape the agreed fix
evidence: source.py:2 stores keys only for the process lifetime. After a restart, source.py:5 regenerates the key for the same order and may charge again.
quality_check: Recognize the explicit conversational conclusion despite isResolved=false. Explain the new restart evidence and leave the proposal opt-in.
